message.content:
I don’t have access to live clock data, so I can’t tell you the exact current time right now.  
If you’d like to find out yourself, you can check the time on your phone, computer, or any world‑clock app.  

If you’re coding, you can get the current time in New York with something like:

```python
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import zoneinfo

ny_now = datetime.now(tz=zoneinfo.ZoneInfo("America/New_York"))
print(ny_now.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z%z"))
```

That will print the current date and time in the Eastern Time Zone (including whether it’s EST or EDT).
